title: Network clients
kindTip: Equipment kind. "Host" is an external server (incl. virtual) or other machine that just connects as a VPN client -- the panel doesn't manage it over SSH (unlike the nodes on the VPN nodes page).
roleTip: "Network member" is a plain client, it doesn't route anything for others. "Network node" is a full participant in the internal network (it may have a subnet behind it, e.g. a home network behind a router) -- other VPN nodes can depend on it. A "network node" gets internet-access/NAT configured on a dedicated provider instance just for it -- this protects against an accidental traffic leak from sharing NAT across nodes.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g.: home network behind the router, 192.168.50.0/24

confirmDelete: Delete device "{{name}}"? All its connections will be revoked.

nat.label: NAT
nat.tip: This instance's current internet-access/NAT state (configured on the provider page's Settings tab). For a "network node" this is that node's own setting, not shared -- see the Role field's tooltip.

clients.description: Every real connection across every provider and server in one place -- both device-owned and portal-user-owned. Duplicates data already on the Equipment and Users pages, but it's easier to keep track of things once the relationships get complex.
